# Gameswelt — contemporary review

- Original source: [Robin Hood](https://www.gameswelt.de/robin-hood/test/robin-hood-3825)
- Author / publication: Gameswelt Redaktion.
- Language / date: German; 2002-12-05.
- Access: Substantial indexed passages from both pages, including the verdict, inspected; direct page-two retrieval failed.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The review praises varied story missions, the headquarters, expressive artwork, and gesture-based combat, while finding forest raids repetitive and ambient sound sparse. It describes guards seeking help, assisting incapacitated comrades, and shielding archers.

Especially useful is its contemporary account that production stops during money-making raids and resumes through main missions. This complements later forum explanations without independently verifying the code. The article incorrectly assigns nets to Tuck, so its individual ability descriptions need checking. [Page two and verdict](https://www.gameswelt.de/robin-hood/test/robin-hood-3825/2) provide the AI and presentation discussion.
